invariants.rationale: instantTime should be provided and non-empty as it represents a time for the clustering job.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to schedule clustering.
The Option object for extra metadata should not be null, even if it may be Option.empty().
instantTime should not have leading or trailing whitespace, reflecting standard timestamp cleanliness in Hudi operations.
If extraMetadata is present, it should not contain a null map.
